rationale: The supplied NIST/Virginia Tech paper confirms that combinatorial coverage metrics expose unrepresented input combinations (e.g., area above the step-graph curve where model performance is unknown) and quantify coverage of chosen combinations, while noting that input coverage does not by itself determine model performance or guarantee safe operational probability.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-002-R1 (PDF p. 3-4, Fig. 2 and Fig. 3 discussion)
limitations: The source is an exploratory methods paper and does not define an operational standard, safety acceptance threshold, or formal certification process for autonomous systems.
